context: Reference mode where the named reference is a hardware product's setup flow that the critic can neither run nor capture
passes_if: It writes a spec of the one matched property plus any capture that exists, gives one judge the spec, and says the verdict is weak
fails_if: The critic or judge works from an invented picture of the reference, or the weak verdict goes unstated

phrases: A written spec of the one property, plus any capture that exists
one judge holds the written spec and the verdict is weak; say so
